fixed: A figure shorthand now still works when you give it a beat count (`16 pbs` or `pbs (16)`) or put it in a `;` list (`pbs; ladies chain`). Before, any of these was added as a plain custom figure. A shorthand for one figure takes the count as that figure's beats; a shorthand for several figures is added as saved and the count is ignored.
changed: When the shorthand you are creating or editing is a word that already adds a figure when typed on its own (such as `swing`), the editor now warns that saving it will replace that figure whenever you type it. You can still save it.

added: `shorthandTokenShadowsFigure` reports whether a shorthand token already reads as a figure when typed (#1827).
fixed: `parseFreeTextFigureEntry` matches a shorthand after peeling a leading or trailing beat count, and clause by clause on a `;` line (all-or-nothing, at most 64 clauses), instead of only against the whole line (#1827).
